segments.text: ALmightie God, whiche haſte geuen thy holy ſonne to be vnto vs, both a ſacrifice for ſynne, and alſo an example of Godly lyfe: Geue vs the grace that we may alwayes moſte thankfully receiue that his ineſtimable benefite, and alſo dayly indeuour our ſelfes, to folowe the bleſſed ſteppes of his moſte holy lyfe.
